## opencode-browser-agent v2.0.8

Lessons from a real, long-running browser session are now part of the skill, plus two real install fixes.

### Added

- **Skill 4e — daemon detach recovery**: "Daemon version mismatch" / stray "launched browser" symptoms, `tab list` as a recovery probe, re-attach with a NEW session name, stale daemons ignoring an explicit `--cdp` port (error names a different port than the flag), the wedged `starting...` state in `chrome://inspect`, toggle-based debugging being invisible to the Win32 `CommandLine` filter, and the transient `DevToolsActivePort` file.
- **Skill 4j — forms, typeahead and in-page JS**: persistent eval context (always wrap evals in an IIFE), framework-controlled inputs (native prototype setter + `input`/`change` events), "element covered" click recovery, typeahead re-snapshot flow, refs dying inside modals without navigation, and additive-form verification by row count.
- **Skill 4a**: base64 injection pattern for non-ASCII (Persian/RTL) text, UTF-8 console encoding + snapshot-to-file reading, PS 5.1 stderr noise note.
- Short rules 13-14; section 9 (failures) updated with matching symptoms.

### Fixed

- `install.ps1` now **creates** deploy target directories instead of silently skipping them (a fresh machine ended up with no installed copy).
- `opencode.json` plugin URL is built with `[System.Uri]::AbsoluteUri`, so paths containing spaces no longer break plugin loading.

### Changed

- Dependency floor raised to `agent-browser >= 0.43.0` (latest upstream; 0.41+ carries the daemon/CDP fixes the skill documents). README badge updated. `package-lock.json` committed.
Docs: add non-affiliation note per anomalyco/opencode guidance.
Fix: make skill/tool registration non-fatal so load_agent_browser_skill stays available even if skill registration fails. Bump version.
Maintenance release. Bumps version; keeps repo active for awesome-opencode entry requirements.
Register agent-browser skill in OpenCode /skills list.
